national-library-of-georgia-building-iii.name: National Library of Georgia — Building III
national-library-of-georgia-building-iii.description: A public place for reading, research and intellectual exploration. Cultural programs may offer social opportunities, but another visitor or conversation is never guaranteed.

prosperos-books-and-coffee.name: Prospero’s Books & Coffee
prosperos-books-and-coffee.description: Browse books or sit with coffee in a literary café. A welcoming possibility for solitary reading or conversation, never a promise of company.

dedaena-park.name: Dedaena Park
dedaena-park.address: Dedaena Park, near Dry Bridge, Tbilisi, Georgia
dedaena-park.description: Walk by the Mtkvari River, explore the green space and skatepark, or simply spend time outdoors.

fabrika-tbilisi.name: Fabrika Tbilisi
fabrika-tbilisi.description: A creative courtyard with cafés, shops and cultural spaces. Visitors may browse, make something, or relax without needing company.

abrehot-library.name: Abrehot Library
abrehot-library.address: Abrehot Library, 4 Kilo, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
abrehot-library.description: A public library for reading, research and study; a place to spend time among books and other visitors without presuming interaction.

entoto-park.name: Entoto Park
entoto-park.address: Entoto Park, Gullele, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
entoto-park.description: Wooded paths and outdoor recreation offer a change of surroundings, exercise and time in nature.

unity-park.name: Unity Park
unity-park.address: Unity Park, Arat Kilo, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
unity-park.description: A heritage park with gardens, historical displays and public cultural areas; admission may require tickets.

british-library.name: British Library
british-library.address: 96 Euston Road, London NW1 2DB, United Kingdom
british-library.description: Public reading spaces, exhibitions and events for independent study or intellectual curiosity.

southbank-centre.name: Southbank Centre
southbank-centre.address: Southbank Centre, Belvedere Road, London SE1 8XX, United Kingdom
southbank-centre.description: An arts destination with performances, exhibitions and public spaces to browse and enjoy by the river.

barbican-centre.name: Barbican Centre
barbican-centre.address: Barbican Centre, Silk Street, London EC2Y 8DS, United Kingdom
barbican-centre.description: A cultural centre for cinema, exhibitions, concerts and quieter public areas; availability varies by event.

palacio-galveias-library.name: Biblioteca Palácio Galveias
palacio-galveias-library.description: A municipal library for reading, study and cultural activities, with spaces for independent work and occasional community events.

gulbenkian-gardens.name: Gulbenkian Foundation Gardens
gulbenkian-gardens.description: Landscaped gardens with paths, ponds and quiet places to read, observe nature or simply spend time outdoors.

museu-do-aljube.name: Museu do Aljube — Resistência e Liberdade
museu-do-aljube.description: A museum exploring Portugal's resistance to dictatorship and the history of freedom, inviting quiet reflection and learning.
